profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sentara Health
profile.summary:
I  began my career as a software engineer developing scalable applications and gaining a strong understanding of what makes code production ready. Over time, I transitioned into DevOps to focus on building reliable systems  and optimizing the full software delivery lifecycle.

My expertise spans CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks, and container orchestration that improves release reliability, and increases team throughput. I have worked with tools such as AWS, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Github Actions, and Jenkins to create modular and fault tolerant environments. I frequently develop Python and PowerShell scripts to automate repetitive tasks, manage infrastructure provisioning, and enhance deployment workflows. This aims to reduce manual interventions, increase security, improve recovery times, and ensure systems can scale dynamically with business growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2 - DevOps
positions.description:
- Design and deploy an AI agent to help troubleshoot issues and onboard new employees to enterprise automation by making internal documentation and code repositories available via Azure AI Search.

- Automate infrastructure and resource deployments across AWS and Azure environments to enhance scalability and consistency.

- Lead the migration of source code repositories from Bitbucket to GitHub, streamlining version control processes.

- Migrate CI/CD pipelines from Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, and Jenkins to GitHub Actions, improving pipeline efficiency and standardization.

- Develop reusable GitHub Actions templates to support deployment automation for both Azure and AWS platforms.

- Design and implement security-focused automation to ensure compliance for containerized resources.

- Provision and configure new Azure subscriptions, including the setup of provisioner accounts and self-service automation for deploying core resources such as Key Vault, Storage Accounts, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Event Hubs.

- Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours incident support and resolution.

- Facilitate office hours to support internal teams in adopting and troubleshooting automation solutions.

- Provide technical support to stakeholders and internal customers via support chats, while managing ongoing sprint responsibilities.

- Mentor team members by providing guidance on best practices, code reviews, troubleshooting support, and knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Software Engineer - DevOps
positions.description:
- Migrate deployment pipelines from Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, and Jenkins to GitHub Actions workflows

- Automate AWS and Azure resource deployments using Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices to ensure reliability and code quality.

- Manage and implement upgrades for Azure modules to maintain compatibility, security, and performance across environments.

- Create automation for storage account migration to support disaster recovery effort

- Provide technical support to stakeholders and internal customers via support chats, while managing ongoing sprint responsibilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implement greenfield ETL pipelines to provide data products for marketing analytics using Python, Databricks, and AWS services (IAM, S3, MWAA, DeltaLake, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Cloudwatch/Eventbridge)

- Perform DevOps duties including standing up new repositories with CI/CD for dev, test, and prod environments using Jenkins

- Follow enterprise cloud management standards to maintain security requirements for protected medical data (following HIPAA standard) 

- Mentor other developers across multiple teams

- Demo in-progress features to show business value to stakeholders

- Collect requirements from customers
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Terraform · Teradata · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · Databricks · Apache Airflow · Distributed Systems · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · AWS MWAA · Jenkins · DevOps

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a greenfield event driven system using a
choreographed saga pattern to handle financial transactions for
multiple products.

- Implemented concurrent processes in Go using channels to
parallelize transactions and increase scalability.

- Stand up and tear down deployed microservices using
Terraform and Kubernetes (EKS) in AWS.

- Setup and teardown development environments, as well as
format, build, and test code changes using Github Actions.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Git · Bash · Apache Kafka · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Test Automation · Software Development · Terraform · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Distributed Systems · gRPC · Amazon Dynamodb · Linux · Agile Methodologies · Unit Testing · Microservices

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintain and enhance existing microservices written in Go that
interface with GraphQL.

- Implemented a version control feature in Go to provide a git-like
workflow for an internal requirements management tool with
concurrent data processing for merge requests.

- Manage sandbox deployment environments using Terraform
and Kubernetes.

- Enhance existing CI suite implemented using Jenkins.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Design, develop, and release a full stack application using MongoDB, Express, Angular, and Node. This full stack application was used to automate the deployment of internal library documentation.

- Participate in the design, development, testing, and production release stages for microcontroller firmware

- Implemented a python module to automate attenuation levels applied over RF connections & integrated into the R&D department’s testing framework

- Developed a C++ standalone emulator application to be used by the infrastructure team when testing and designing HMI displays

projects.title: SmartRoutine
projects.description: This SaaS application is written in Go and was created to help me streamline my morning routine. I am able to register devices to activate at a given offset relative to an alarm set on my phone. This allows me to change the alarm time without having to reset any of my devices.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.description:
I am currently building an interactive, web-based portfolio. It includes descriptions of previous projects, as well as links to their code bases. I implemented email redirection on the server, so any communications initiated through the application will be sent to my personal email for faster response time. 

Future updates to this application will focus on mobile view scalability and file storage for the database.
